question: Submission description (a short paragraph)
answer: A frozen supervised regression model over aggregate error features produced by a two-stage MQM-style Gemma 4 31B detector (cuni-v14 task 1 submission). The constrained weighted-error regression was fit and selected only on WMT25 training data using underlying-document grouped validation, excludes prediction failures from fitting, and uses a frozen train-mean fallback. It does not use reference translations. This submission covers the eight WMT26 high-priority language pairs plus English-Czech, Czech-Ukrainian, and all released English-Chinese variants.
